cluster_name.description: Cluster name used for config/auth discovery (e.g., /etc/ceph/cluster.conf)

rados_user_name.description: RADOS user name (TYPE.ID); must be valid for the service instance

mon_addresses.description: Explicit monitor addresses (list of host:port strings); overrides mon lookup in ceph.conf

log_to_stderr.description: If true, run in foreground and log to stderr (equivalent to -d flag); otherwise use standard logging

config_path.description: Absolute path to ceph.conf if not the default (/etc/ceph/ceph.conf)
